select v.vendor_name, sum(b.stake) / 100 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.rounds r on r.id = b.round_ref
join game.tables t on t.table_no = r.tbl
join game.games g on g.code = t.g_code
join game.vendors v on v.vid = g.vendor
group by v.vendor_name;

select v.vendor_name, sum(b.stake) / 100 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.rounds r on r.id = b.round_ref
join game.tables t on t.table_no = r.tbl
join game.games g on g.code = t.g_code
join game.vendors v on v.vid = g.vendor
group by v.vendor_name;

SELECT r.region_name, count(*) AS sessions
FROM app.sessions s
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON s.player_id = p.id
JOIN crm.agents a ON p.agent_code = a.code
JOIN crm.regions r ON a.region_no = r.no
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY sessions DESC

select
    r.region_name,
    count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions s
join app.devices d on d.device_uid = s.device_uid
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = d.owner_ref
join crm.agents a on a.code = p.agent_code
join crm.regions r on r.no = a.region_no
group by r.region_name
order by sessions desc

select r.region_name, count(*) as rejected_withdrawals
from fin.requests req
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = req.user_ref
join crm.agents a on a.code = p.agent_code
join crm.regions r on r.no = a.region_no
where req.type = 1 and req.status = 3
group by r.region_name
order by r.region_name;

select t3.region_name, count(*) as rejected_withdrawals
from fin.requests t0
join crm.player_accounts t1 on t1.id = t0.user_ref
join crm.agents t2 on t2.code = t1.agent_code
join crm.regions t3 on t3.no = t2.region_no
where t0.type = 2 and t0.status = 3
group by t3.region_name
order by t3.region_name

SELECT a.agent_name, SUM(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 AS deposit_usd
FROM fin.requests r
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON p.id = r.user_ref
JOIN crm.agents a ON a.code = p.agent_code
WHERE r.type = 1 AND r.status = 2
GROUP BY a.agent_name;

select a.agent_name, sum(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 as deposit_usd
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
join crm.agents a on a.code = p.agent_code
where r.type = 1 and r.status = 2
group by a.agent_name
order by a.agent_name;

SELECT count(DISTINCT p.id) AS player_count
FROM crm.player_accounts p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM game.bets b
    JOIN game.rounds r ON r.id = b.round_ref
    JOIN game.tables t ON t.table_no = r.tbl
    JOIN game.games g ON g.code = t.g_code
    JOIN game.vendors v ON v.vid = g.vendor
    WHERE b.member_ref = p.id
      AND v.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fin.requests req
    WHERE req.user_ref = p.id
      AND req.type = 1
      AND req.status = 2
);

select count(distinct b.member_ref) as players
from game.bets b
join game.rounds r on r.id = b.round_ref
join game.tables t on t.table_no = r.tbl
join game.games g on g.code = t.g_code
join game.vendors v on v.vid = g.vendor
where v.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
  and b.member_ref in (
    select user_ref
    from fin.requests
    where type = 1
      and status = 2
  );

select d.platform, count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions s
join app.devices d on d.device_uid = s.device_uid
where s.player_id in (select user_ref from fin.requests where status = 1)
group by d.platform
order by d.platform;

select d.platform, count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions s
join app.devices d on d.device_uid = s.device_uid
where d.owner_ref in (select r.user_ref from fin.requests r where r.status = 1)
group by d.platform;

select v.vendor_name, sum(b.stake) / 100.0 as stake_usd

SELECT r.region_name AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM app.sessions s
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON s.player_id = p.id
JOIN crm.agents a ON p.agent_code = a.code
JOIN crm.regions r ON a.region_no = r.no

select t4.region_name as region_name, count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions t0
join app.devices t1 on t1.device_uid = t0.device_uid

join crm.agents t3 on t3.code = t2.agent_code

select reg.region_name, count(*) as rejected_withdrawals
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
join crm.agents a on a.code = p.agent_code
join crm.regions reg on reg.no = a.region_no

select t3.region_name, count(*) as rejected_withdrawals
from fin.requests t0
join crm.player_accounts t1 on t1.id = t0.user_ref
join crm.agents t2 on t2.code = t1.agent_code

JOIN crm.agents a ON a.code = p.agent_code

select a.agent_name,
       sum(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 as deposit_usd

SELECT count(DISTINCT p.id) AS players
FROM crm.player_accounts p
JOIN game.bets b ON b.member_ref = p.id
JOIN game.rounds ro ON ro.id = b.round_ref
JOIN game.tables t ON t.table_no = ro.tbl
JOIN game.games g ON g.code = t.g_code
JOIN game.vendors v ON v.vid = g.vendor
WHERE v.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fin.requests r
    WHERE r.user_ref = p.id
      AND r.type = 1
      AND r.status = 2
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.member_ref) AS players
FROM game.bets b
JOIN game.rounds r ON b.round_ref = r.id
JOIN game.tables t ON r.tbl = t.table_no
JOIN game.games g ON t.g_code = g.code
JOIN game.vendors v ON g.vendor = v.vid
WHERE v.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
  AND b.member_ref IN (
    SELECT user_ref FROM fin.requests WHERE type = 1 AND status = 2
  );

select d.platform, count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions s
join app.devices d on d.device_uid = s.device_uid
where s.player_id in (select user_ref from fin.requests where status = 2)
